question: What is the average total quantity across all final packaging combinations, considering only the leaf-level items within each combination after fully expanding any nested packaging relationships?
sql:
-- Let me verify the calculations manually:
-- Root 531 (Pallet of L): 531 -> 521 (qty 12), 521 -> 502 (qty 72) => 12 * 72 = 864 ✓
-- Root 532 (Pallet of M): 532 -> 522 (qty 20), 522 -> 501 (qty 36) => 20 * 36 = 720 ✓
-- Root 533 (Pallet Mix MS): 
--   533 -> 522 (qty 10), 522 -> 501 (qty 36) => 10 * 36 = 360
--   533 -> 523 (qty 20), 523 -> 502 (qty 30) => 20 * 30 = 600
--   Total: 360 + 600 = 960 ✓
-- Root 534 (Pallet Mix SG):
--   534 -> 523 (qty 20), 523 -> 502 (qty 30) => 20 * 30 = 600
--   534 -> 524 (qty 16), 524 -> 511 (qty 8), 511 -> 501 (qty 3) => 16 * 8 * 3 = 384
--   534 -> 524 (qty 16), 524 -> 511 (qty 8), 511 -> 502 (qty 2) => 16 * 8 * 2 = 256
--   Total: 600 + 384 + 256 = 1240 ✓

-- Now compute the average across all final packaging combinations
SELECT AVG(1.0 * total_leaf_qty) as average_total_quantity
FROM (
    WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
        SELECT 
            p.id as root_id,
            pr.contains_id,
            pr.qty as path_qty
        FROM packaging p
        JOIN packaging_relations pr ON p.id = pr.packaging_id
        WHERE p.id IN (
            SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations
            EXCEPT
            SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations
        )
        
        UNION ALL
        
        SELECT 
            pt.root_id,
            pr.contains_id,
            pt.path_qty * pr.qty
        FROM packaging_tree pt
        JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pt.contains_id = pr.packaging_id
    ),
    tree_with_leaf AS (
        SELECT 
            pt.root_id,
            pt.contains_id,
            pt.path_qty,
            CASE WHEN pt.contains_id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END as is_leaf
        FROM packaging_tree pt
    )
    SELECT 
        root_id,
        SUM(CASE WHEN is_leaf = 1 THEN path_qty ELSE 0 END) as total_leaf_qty
    FROM tree_with_leaf
    GROUP BY root_id
)
